title: AmsterDoom: Roguelite - Release Trailer (EN) - Out now!
author: Colindp4
selftext:
**I used AI to turn a classic Dutch FPS into a roguelite – AmsterDoom**  
  
I've been working on **AmsterDoom: Roguelite**, a retro FPS based on the original Dutch game AmsterDoom.

I've used AI to help with development, but a lot of work was done manually too. I've had to modify 3D models, adjust weapons, fix animations, work with original game assets and build new gameplay mechanics.

The game now features roguelite mechanics, weapon upgrades, loot crates, increasingly difficult enemies, bosses and different levels.

It's still a work in progress, so there are definitely bugs and things that need improving.

I recently released it on [itch.io](http://itch.io) and thought I'd share it here. Curious what other AI-assisted game developers think!

**Play it here:**  
[https://colindp4.itch.io/amsterdoom-roguelite](https://colindp4.itch.io/amsterdoom-roguelite)
